item_name: Rothco Public Safety Embroidered Watch Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Public Safety Embroidered Watch Caps are designed for security guards, police officers, and other public safety officials on duty. These comfortable caps feature embroidered public safety lettering on the front of the folded brim, with variations including police and security. Constructed from acrylic material, they offer exceptional warmth, lightweight comfort, and durability to retain their shape and color. The double-layer construction provides added warmth, making the beanie hat suitable for cold weather environments.
